source: JUM-23 baseline + local Bun 1.3.14 samples, recorded before the pin moved to 1.3.13 (JUM-708); CI wall-clock out of scope (Req 106 §5)

bunLocalSamples.command: bun test apps/backend-template/test/unit/modules/Users (Users domain, cold); bun run test:unit (full unit suite, includes workspace:build:packages prestep)
bunLocalSamples.note: Users-domain cold sample: 29 files / 322 tests / 1458ms bun-reported + 1.47s wall. Full suite grew 7.9x in test count since the jestEra baseline (518->4074) while wall time stayed roughly flat (157.6s->158.0s). One pre-existing failing test (UserService.deadLetter.test.ts) unrelated to this measurement.

toolchainNote: These samples were taken under Bun 1.3.14. The pin moved down to 1.3.13 because 1.3.14 rejects a lockfile it writes itself for some dependency trees (JUM-708). The numbers are left as recorded rather than adjusted: a timing nobody measured is worse than a timing with a stated provenance.
